verdict.rationale: pnpm has a public GitHub repository (github.com/pnpm/pnpm) with README content, which implies the source is readable. However, nothing in the pack states the license the code is released under. `pnpm licenses list` (pnpm-docs-20) only reports the licenses of installed dependencies and says nothing about pnpm's own license. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved open-source license for pnpm itself, and confirmation that the full source (including the Rust rewrite) is public.
